meta.title: 晋升答辩遇到不会的问题怎么办
meta.title_en: What to Do When You Can't Answer in a Promotion Defense
meta.topic: 职场晋升 · 答辩三类问题与心态

scenes.context: 延续性问题就你的分享展开，挑战性问题质疑你的逻辑，发散性问题防刷题。
sentences: 第一种问题叫做延续性问题。
The first kind is the follow-up question.
follow-up（延续性）
挑战性问题就是质疑你的逻辑。
Challenging questions question your reasoning.
challenging（挑战性）
发散性问题防止你们准备后刷题。
Open-ended questions stop you from gaming the system.
open-ended（发散性）
paraphrase: Questions that dig deeper into what you presented.
Outside judges ask things you couldn't rehearse.
scenes.speak: The first kind is the follow-up question. Challenging questions question your reasoning. Open-ended questions stop you from gaming the system.

scenes.context: 问题可能有弦外之音，答对答错不是最重要的。
sentences: 遇到紧急情况首先不要慌。
In a tight spot, the first rule is: don't panic.
tight spot（紧急情况）
人家的问题可能有弦外之音。
The question may carry subtext.
subtext（弦外之音）
你答的对不对并不是最重要。
Whether you're right isn't the most important thing.
not the most important（不是最重要）
paraphrase: There may be more to the question than meets the eye.
Keep calm and think before you speak.
scenes.speak: In a tight spot, the first rule is: don't panic. The question may carry subtext. Whether you're right isn't the most important thing.

scenes.context: 答辩看人才画像与素质，追求稳定就留在基层，接受不确定性才能往上走。
sentences: 它是看人才的画像和素质。
They're assessing your profile and caliber.
caliber（素质）
如果你追求稳定，就该在下面干活。
If you crave stability, stay at the working level.
crave stability（追求稳定）
凡是往上走的人都要应对巨大的不确定性。
Anyone moving up must handle massive uncertainty.
uncertainty（不确定性）
paraphrase: What kind of person you are matters more than the answers.
Embrace change and be ready to adapt.
scenes.speak: They're assessing your profile and caliber. If you crave stability, stay at the working level. Anyone moving up must handle massive uncertainty.

practice: Follow-ups that dig into what you presented.
遇到不会的问题先怎样？
Don't panic — the question may carry subtext.
Your talent profile and caliber, not right or wrong.
追求稳定的人应该怎样？
Stay at the working level — growth demands uncertainty.
